experiment.name: hf_patchtst_revin_no_volume_patch14_14
experiment.description: hf_patchtst_revin_no_volume (step 4) with patch_length=14, patch_stride=14 (no overlap, 5 patches) -- follow-up to a wider patch-geometry sweep lost to a Colab disconnect before its checkpoints could be pushed. That sweep's forecasting metrics for this exact config were retained (printed output survived locally) and pointed to patch length 14 itself -- not overlap -- being the driver behind the (14, 7) config's earlier win. This run retrains just this one config to get a pushable checkpoint for backtesting. Everything else identical to step 4: 20 epochs, flat LR=6e-4, plain RevIN MSE, no directional term.

loss_weights.note: unweighted -- single RevIN-normalized MSE over the 4 OHLC channels
